column2: Thank you.{wait}{clear}But never mind me. You should rest when you can, too.
Yes... I think about many things, but before I know it, I seem to keep coming back to the same ones.
As an imperial knight, I attended many ceremonies and escort duties...{wait}{clear}Even that feels like a very long time ago now...
Thank you. I'm eating properly.{wait}{clear}It would be a problem if I had no strength when it counts.{wait}{clear}Besides, since leaving the Empire, I've been able to eat at a leisurely pace.
Yes... I know. Don't worry.
I'm fine. Don't make that face. Rest easy.
Thank you. I'm fine... I know...
Yes, I'm fine...
Worrying now won't get us anywhere, will it? I'll just go into battle without letting my guard down.
Yes... I understand...
Don't worry so much. I won't let my guard down against any enemy.
I'm sure you'll be fine, Leyla.
Yes... Thank you. But I won't let my guard down.
Don't say it with such a worried face. I'll be fine.
I'm fine. I know you're worried, but what good is it if you can't stay calm?
No, this is because I wasn't strong enough. I'm sorry I'm so pathetic...
Yes, I'm fine. But I'm sorry it came to this.
I know how you feel, but hearing that only makes me feel more pathetic...{wait}{clear}Next time, I'll live up to your expectations...
It's all right, don't worry. It's my own fault I was wounded...
It's all right, I don't need anything.{wait}{clear}Just stay by my side a little while... Having you here calms me, somehow...
Don't worry. I overestimated my own strength...{wait}{clear}It's shameful for a knight...
It's all right. Don't worry.{wait}{clear}Being relied on makes me happy. And unless I push myself to some degree, I can't go any further.
It's my fault I couldn't size up the enemy's strength...{wait}{clear}It was a good lesson...
Even an angel like you says harsh things...{wait}{clear}But if I were in your position, I'm sure I'd say the same.{wait}{clear}I was like that, back in the Empire...
...I'm sorry. I'm always making you worry.{wait}{clear}Once these wounds heal, I'll take your requests again.
The Empire
What kind of country is the Grosain Empire?
Our country... has a very long history and tradition. Its people take pride in that, and so do I...{wait}{clear}But now something has begun to go wrong... Because of that father and son...
The cause of the world's turmoil...
The Empire tormenting innocent people... I can't bear it...{wait}{clear}But... something else is...
If peace returns to this world... surely...
